entries.text: Free calculators for yardage, backing, binding and borders, and printable planners to keep every project on track.
Half-finished quilts pile up, and one wrong yardage sum can waste fabric you paid good money for.
Each project has its numbers worked out and written down before you cut, and the unfinished ones are on a list you can actually work through.
entries.note: No promise of finishing more quilts.

entries.text: Pick the calculator for the job, enter your quilt size in inches, and it gives the fabric and cutting figures. Print the result or copy it into your planner.
entries.note: Check against the live calculators' inputs before shipping.

entries.text: A printable PDF planner for your quilt projects.
entries.note: The blueprint has no contents spec for the planner; Product & Offer should add the real page list from the existing file.

entries.text: Everything in the $8 planner plus a gift-quilt deadline planner, yardage and cutting worksheets from crib to king, a UFO tracker and one original, tested pattern in several sizes. Printer-friendly, large type.

entries.text: They do, and our calculators are free too. The planner is for keeping the numbers, deadlines and unfinished projects together in one printed place.
Keep buying fabric at your local shop. The planner is a download you print at home, so you can take your yardage list with you when you go.
Print the planner pages you need, then start with the project you most want to finish.
